article_content: (CNN) -- Penn State University, which faced significant controversy following the Jerry Sandusky scandal, will host a sexual abuse prevention conference featuring boxer Sugar Ray Leonard and advocate Elizabeth Smart. The October 29-30 event comes years after Sandusky's 2012 conviction for sexually abusing multiple young boys while serving as an assistant football coach. 'Penn State has committed to leading in child abuse research and prevention over the past nine months, implementing measures to enhance community safety,' stated university president Rodney Erickson in a conference announcement. Leonard, a boxing legend and reality TV personality, revealed in his 2021 autobiography that he was sexually abused by an Olympic coach early in his career. Smart gained national attention in 2002 when kidnapped at age 14 and abused during her nine-month captivity. Her abductor, Brian David Mitchell, is serving a life sentence. Following Sandusky's conviction on 45 counts of child sexual abuse, Penn State has faced severe consequences including a $60 million NCAA fine (2022), four-year football postseason ban, and vacated wins from 1998-2011. A 2022 report by former FBI director Louis Freeh criticized university leaders for 'consistent disregard' toward abuse victims.

article_content: Authorities in northwest China have recovered twin girls stolen from Fuping County Maternal and Child Health Care Hospital, arresting nine suspects in a baby trafficking ring. Obstetrician Zhang Shuxia stands accused of convincing parents to abandon newborns by fabricating severe health diagnoses. This follows the recent reunion of another trafficked infant with his family. Police reports reveal 55 child abduction cases in Shaanxi province, with Zhang implicated in 26 instances. Three local officials and hospital administrators have been removed from their posts. Parents Wang Yanyan and Qi Kunfeng described Zhang's manipulation tactics after their twins' May 29 birth. 'She feigned urgency, insisting our babies had congenital defects and would be disabled,' Wang recalled. 'We trusted her as a family friend - never suspecting she'd sell our children.' In a separate case, Dong Wan surrendered her son on July 16 after being told he wouldn't survive. The healthy baby was sold three times across multiple provinces before recovery. 'They pressured me to let the hospital handle his 'final days',' Dong shared during an emotional reunion. Despite China's strict anti-trafficking laws, including capital punishment, the illegal trade thrives due to profit motives and cultural preferences for male children. Analysts link the crisis to historical population policies and insufficient legal education.

article_content: Bollywood stars Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt have maintained their daughter Raha's privacy since her November 2022 birth. During the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit, the first-time parents explained their cautious approach to media exposure. 'We're bursting with pride, but want to be thoughtful about sharing her image,' Alia shared. Following a January 2023 request to paparazzi during a family outing with Neetu Kapoor, the couple clarified this isn't a permanent stance. 'As she grows and we gain parenting confidence, we'll decide the right time – whether soon or later,' Alia noted. The name Raha, chosen by the child's grandmother, holds multicultural significance, meaning 'divine path' along with interpretations of joy, peace, and comfort across various languages. Their social media announcement highlighted how Raha has brought profound meaning to their family journey.
